metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Fugaro, the fleeting cloud workers that run coding-agent tasks and always end with a pull request.

plugins.name: fugaro
plugins.description: Six skills for Fugaro: set a repository up, work with runs, route work between cloud and local, plan parallel work, upgrade a checkout to the installed fugaro, and read and record a project's orchestrator state. Fugaro runs coding-agent tasks in fleeting cloud containers and always ends with a pull request.
